edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted caller identity used by bid() to accept the bid, set winning and emit Bid
tx.origin is used in the authorization check msg.sender == tx.origin to block contracts
block.timestamp gates the bid window and the lastBidTime deadline in bid()
block.timestamp determines whether end() may be called via lastBidTime/startBidTime deadlines
block.timestamp gates pull() through startBidTime.add(auctionLength)
block.timestamp is compared against bid and auction deadlines in live()
bid() performs an external ETH transfer to the previous winner before updating lastBid, winning and lastBidTime
end() makes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom before any state variable (ended) is updated
end() sends the haus fee with an external transfer before setting ended = true
end() sends the remaining balance to the seller externally before the ended flag is written
pull() performs an external ERC1155 transfer before setting ended = true
safeTransferFrom to the winner contract may re-enter through onERC1155Received, which is implemented by this contract
safeTransferFrom to the seller contract may trigger the onERC1155Received hook
winning is the recipient address of the refund transfer in bid()
lastBid is the value transferred back to the previous winner
token address is the target of the IERC1155 external call in end()
id is passed as the token id to safeTransferFrom in end()
winning is used as the recipient of the ERC1155 token in end()
seller is the recipient of the remaining contract balance in end()
haus is the recipient of the computed protocol fee
end() reads the ended guard and writes ended = true at the end
lastBidTime plus bidLength determines the time gate in end()
startBidTime plus auctionLength is part of the time gate in end()
lastBid is the basis of the minimum bid requirement in bid()
lastBidTime is checked against the timestamp and refreshed in bid()
Constructor parameter _start initializes the startBidTime state variable
Constructor parameter _seller initializes the seller state variable
Constructor parameter _haus initializes the haus state variable
Local balance is used to derive the haus fee that is transferred
Local hausFee is the exact amount sent by haus.transfer in end()
